rule #59 reason (console only, everything else identical to the "pfsense" profile above):
NPX-821 measured on 2026-09-05 that this image draws its whole "Enter an option:" menu on
the VGA framebuffer and writes 0 guest bytes to serial. NPX-1200 later changed the single
"pfsense" key to serial/telnet for the new memstick-serial build, which left this legacy
image with a silent serial xterm and no VNC door (found live, Wave 17 sweep NPX-153:
console tab opened, blank xterm, no VNC viewer). NPX-821's own comment promised a serial
build would get its own key while this one stayed; this restores that. No day0_channel:
the pfsense-cdrom-copy channel types over serial, which this image never answers.
